race.comment: JARBARDAR (1) can bounce back here. He ran second to Threads at Caulfield two back, which is good form, before struggling in a very fast G3 Blue Sapphire last start. Way back in grade now, and he looks far better placed. IN A TIZZY (6) is the main danger after winning a maiden at Cranbourne and then running third at this track in a BM62, beaten just over a length as a well-supported favourite. Profiles nicely. AUTUMN RAINBOW (10) brings the Listed Hill Smith Stakes form, where she was sixth to Kosaji after beginning awkwardly, and did win well this trip prior. Back in trip now but has the talent. GAZERATI (2) was second to Fast Freddie at Bendigo first-up despite being slow away and racing wide. That form looks solid, and he should improve. BALANCE (3) is mixing form, but her best is good enough.
